label: B25-GATE-D-RERUN
title: Run full Gate D on the corrected B25 candidate
scope: 在包含 T-001/T-002/T-004 的同一 B25 候选上，执行完整 Gate D：make test、缓存/MMU/异常定向、随机 seed 1/2/3 × 100k、覆盖记账和 baremetal-C；保留所有断言和 QEMU 严格差分。
writes: build/agents/T-20260908-005/** ignored logs and runtime artifacts
validation: Confirm the detached worktree is exactly the registered candidate and QEMU/plugin/tool hashes are recorded.
Run env VERILATOR_JOBS=1 make test and bash sim/difftest/run_gate_d.sh --parallel under one local resource lock.
Require random_1/random_2/random_3 traces before coverage; record every step, first failure, elapsed/RSS and artifact hashes.
Do not use GamePC, Quartus, assembler, SOF, JTAG, programming, power or board actions.
acceptance: The corrected candidate completes the full Gate D suite with no disabled assertions/reference comparisons and all three random traces present; otherwise preserve the first failure and keep the board gate blocked.

resource.policy: Acquire local for the entire make test + Gate D run; use task-local TMPDIR/build roots; return 75 means wait.

forbidden_regions: shared writable QEMU build outside the serialized plugin build

integrator_review.summary: make test、40/40 M2/R1、32/32 delay2、26/26 P5a、Gate C 7/7、P5a MMU 3/3、P4b 5/5、random 3x100k/300006、coverage 62/62、baremetal-C 200 全部通过。
integrator_review.next: T-042 fresh 25 MHz synthesis/fitter/STA；板级 JTAG/console 只有在有效镜像和明确授权后执行。

correction_record.impact: Metadata ordering defect only; candidate SHA, resource-lock log, Gate D log hash and all PASS results remain unchanged. Frozen handoff/evidence are not rewritten.
